lines.zh: 藤蔓挂在我这一身骨头上。
lines.en: Vines hang off these bones.
I walk the damp floor of the jungle.

lines.zh: 骨节里长出了绿的东西。
lines.en: Green things grow in my joints.
Sunlight doesn't burn me away.
I step over fallen leaves, one by one.
Roots don't trip me.

lines.zh: 我走得像一丛会动的草。
lines.en: I move like a walking thicket.
Leaves carry something of mine.
I climbed up out of the cave.
I pass through slowly.
The vines keep growing on me.
I stand; the vines stir.
This jungle feeds me.

lines.zh: 我的箭袋里长出了蘑菇。
lines.en: Mushrooms are growing in my quiver.
The moss on me thickens.
I listen to the trees above.
A shoot sprouts from a bone seam.
Still as a tree.
Sun comes down through the leaves.
The green on me is deep.
I draw the bow, then lower it.

lines.zh: 你身上穿的衣服很干净。
lines.en: Your clothes are very clean.
You don't fit in this jungle.

lines.zh: 我这张脸已经不太像脸了。
lines.en: This face barely is one anymore.

lines.zh: 你看见我身上的芽了吗？
lines.en: See the shoots on me?

lines.zh: 我手里的东西能碰到你。
lines.en: What I'm holding can reach you.
Step back. The vines catch.
I spent a long time in caves.
You don't fear sun. Neither do I.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠上身，我照旧走着。
lines.en: Vines crawl over me, and I keep walking.
A bone loosened.
A length of vine came off.
That numbed me.
You hit moss, not bone.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，叶子上有痕。
lines.en: I stepped back. Leaves bear the mark.
I never feared pain much.

lines.zh: 骨缝里流出的水是绿的。
lines.en: The fluid from the seam is green.

lines.zh: 丛林的苔，长满我的骨头。
lines.en: Jungle moss grows all over my bones.
Food? I've no use for it.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我闻不出味道。
lines.en: You hold it up. I smell nothing.
I don't eat. The vines do.
That much wouldn't feed anyone.

lines.zh: 我更想要你脚边的东西。
lines.en: I'd rather have what's at your feet.
Don't reach. The vines will move.
Set it down. Let me see.
Keep it. It suits you better.
That smells too fresh.
Bumping me leaves you cold and damp.
You stepped on my vines.
I'm light but hard.
Not so close. Something sticky.
Your sleeve got damp backing off.
I turn aside; the bones click.
Your shoulder hit my ribs.
Moss smeared on the ground.
I'm not easily knocked aside.
One vine is still on you.
That's nothing to do with me now.
Two of us and the vines tangle.
Don't keep watching us.

lines.zh: 骨头和骨头碰在一起很响。
lines.en: Bone on bone is loud.
It has thicker moss than me.

lines.zh: 我们缠了一会儿才分开。
lines.en: We stayed tangled a while.
A layer of green dust fell.

lines.zh: 我们不是那样长起来的。
lines.en: That's not how we grew.

lines.zh: 之后它往林子深处去了。
lines.en: Afterwards it went deeper into the jungle.
There isn't much to say about it.
I pick up a dead branch.
This will make an arrow.
I picked up your arrow.
There are vines of mine on the ground.
I snapped it in two.
Bone hands aren't nimble.
I picked it up and dropped it.
I'll keep this pile of leaves.
I'm steady when I hold the bow.
You dropped that thing.
You're standing on my ground.
I saw you from behind the tree.
The arrow's already nocked.
There's no one else in this grove.
I'm raising the bow.
Retreating to the roots won't help.
My vines get there before I do.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，别的人不算。
lines.en: The target is you. Nobody else.
I'll just walk over slowly.
The vines move first, and the bones follow.

lines.zh: 太阳照不到我们的位置。
lines.en: The sun doesn't reach our spot.
That iron on you rattles.

lines.zh: 树根已经缠上我的脚踝。
lines.en: Tree roots have already wrapped around my ankles.

lines.zh: 你的脚印留在了湿土上。
lines.en: Your prints are in the wet soil.
This arrow won't be wasted.
There's something on this arrowhead.
I hang from the tree and watch.
These vines block your way.
No hurry. I walk slowly.
You're in the cave. I wait at the mouth.
I follow the grass you flattened.

lines.zh: 你没听见我拉弓的声音。
lines.en: You didn't hear the bow.
I know every tree here.
Your lamp doesn't reach.
I drew a vine to your feet.
Climb up and I'm up there.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在叶子里很响。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud in the leaves.
There's a wet gully ahead.
I follow silently.

lines.zh: 你退到那棵大树下就停了。
lines.en: Under that big tree you'll stop.
I've taken my position.
This arrow goes through leaves.

lines.zh: 你身上已经有我的东西了。
lines.en: Something of mine is already on you.
I raise a hand; the joints click.
This one comes with vines.
You got caught for a moment.
My fingers are cold as wood.
Light blow, but it numbs.
I strike with the end of the bow.
You backed two steps, still panting.
There's wet mud on these bones.
You didn't block that.
A vine is on your calf now.
My arm is longer than it looks.
You shouldn't have come under the tree.
There isn't much strength in this.
One swing was enough.
Starting to feel numb?
You won't find the way back.
I stand up out of the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 这身骨头是在这里长满的。
lines.en: These bones were overgrown here.
The cave damp fed me.
I rise from the tree roots.
The sounds of the jungle changed.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着地下的土。
lines.en: I'm still carrying underground soil.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，看见绿色。
lines.en: First I opened my eyes: green.
There's a shape in the tree.

lines.zh: 我不怕太阳，我生在这里。
lines.en: Sun doesn't bother me. I grew here.

lines.zh: 这一片是我常来的地方。
lines.en: This is a place I come to often.
I raise the bow slowly.
The leaves are wet.
I drop down out of the canopy.
Moss spreads out from my feet.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上的绿全焦了。
lines.en: Fire scorched all the green on me.
The landing loosened a few bones.
Water soaked right through me.

lines.zh: 气浪把我身上的藤吹光了。
lines.en: The blast stripped every vine off me.
The arrow passed between bones and stuck.

lines.zh: 这一下绕过了我的骨头。
lines.en: That went around my bones.
I don't eat, and I don't need to.
Lightning struck and the bones went white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有叶子可以抓。
lines.en: There's no leaf to hold in the void.
